name: e-Grantz 3.0 Post-matric scholarship services
description: Official Kerala portal for educational-assistance schemes for post-matric students. Individual scheme eligibility, awards and document requirements are determined in the portal and by the relevant department.
otherEligibilityRules: The official portal determines schemes visible to an eligible student after registration.
applicationInstructions: Complete One Time Registration.
Create the student profile and qualification in Student Login.
Use Apply for Scholarship to view eligible schemes.

name: PM YASASVI Top Class School Scheme — 2023 reference
provider: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of India
description: An archived 2023 official notice for PM YASASVI Top Class Schools. This record is historical reference only; it does not indicate a current application window.
otherEligibilityRules: The archived notice refers to merit through the YASASVI Entrance Test.
applicationInstructions: Treat this as an archive. Check current official notices before relying on any eligibility or award detail.
awardAmount: Archived 2023 notice: up to ₹75,000 p.a. for Class 9/10; up to ₹1,25,000 p.a. for Class 11/12.

sourceReferences.title: PM YASASVI 2023 notice hosted by e-Grantz

name: e-Grantz 3.0 online application guide
description: Verified official application guidance for Kerala's e-Grantz portal. It is a service guide rather than a separate funding programme; individual scheme conditions remain provider-controlled.
otherEligibilityRules: The FAQ says post-matric students are directed to One Time Registration and the student login flow.
applicationInstructions: Use One Time Registration.
Log in, complete profile details, add qualification, then use Apply for Scholarship.
